cross_artifact.asserts: two runs being differenced share a CPU baseline, so the difference is attributable to the change under test
cross_artifact.detail: the CPU baseline moved 18.0x between pre-gqa-dev0.json (6226.8 ms) and post-gqa-dev0.json (345.2 ms). No Vulkan-EP change can make the CPU EP 18.0x faster, so the machine moved. Any speedup differenced across these two runs measures the machine, not the change.

note: admissibility is about provenance, not speed. A slow honest number passes; a fast number whose conditions cannot be reconstructed does not.
